records.Subject: Assured Monthly Fee
records.Description: Customer unhappy with monthly fee being charged when new customers on same product do not get charged this fee.
records.IDR_Complainant_Desired_Outcome__c: All fee's to be reimbursed back to customers account and fee waiver loaded for future
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: Customer reimbursed $180.00 for fees charged since new customer waiver was introduced. Fee waiver loader to prevent fee being charged moving forward
records.IDR_Systemic_Issue_Description__c: In January 2018 any new applicants would not be charged a $6 monthly fee for the service. No work was done to apply fee waivers to existing customer accounts causing frustration with loyal customers.

records.Subject: Car insurance claim review request
records.Description: Customer wants his car insurance claim reviewed
records.IDR_Systemic_Issue_Description__c: In January 2018 any new applicants would not be charged a $6 monthly fee for the service. No work was done to apply fee waivers to existing customer accounts causing frustration with loyal customers.

records.Subject: Life Insurance Policy Cancellation
records.Description: Customer felt pressured into purchasing life insurance policy over the phone. Called within Product cooling off period to cancel policy. Policy was not cancelled. Customer had thought it was cancelled but has just seen the annual premium charged to his account.

records.Subject: Frequent Flyer Reward Point Allocation
records.Description: Customer applied for QFF Black card with the promotional offer of 150000 Qantas Frequent Flyer points. He has not yet received the points and is not happy he needs to wait 3 months (as stated in the t's and c's) for points to be allocated. Application was completed with me in branch. Ts and Cs were provided to the customer.
records.IDR_Complainant_Desired_Outcome__c: Customer wants points allocated immediately and an additional 100,000 points for the inconvenience.
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: AFCA are in favor of the resolution proposed. No further action required.

records.Subject: Mail being sent to incorrect address despite being notified
records.Description: Non-Customer visited branch to advise receiving mail for customer. Address on personal accounts was updated but not business accounts. Business account correspondence continues to be sent to address where customer no longer resides.
records.IDR_Complainant_Desired_Outcome__c: Contact customer and update address for all accounts
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: Address updated. Verbal confirmation provided to non-customer of actions taken.
